SELECT 
    CASE WHEN atom_id IN ('TR110_2', 'TR110_3', 'TR110_4', 'TR340_26', 'TR340_44', 'TR340_8') THEN atom_id ELSE atom_id2 END as iodine_atom,
    COUNT(*) as bond_count
FROM df
WHERE atom_id IN ('TR110_2', 'TR110_3', 'TR110_4', 'TR340_26', 'TR340_44', 'TR340_8')
   OR atom_id2 IN ('TR110_2', 'TR110_3', 'TR110_4', 'TR340_26', 'TR340_44', 'TR340_8')
GROUP BY iodine_atom
